http._comment: 0.0.0.0 binds every interface so other devices on the LAN can reach the game at http://<this-machine-ip>:5168. localhost here would bind the loopback only and refuse every non-local connection. launchBrowser is off because Chromium refuses to navigate to a 0.0.0.0 URL, which is what VS/dotnet run would auto-open from applicationUrl -- open http://localhost:5168 yourself instead. The old launchUrl was 'swagger', but this project configures no Swagger/OpenAPI, so it only ever opened a 404.

http-localhost-only._comment: Loopback-only variant for ordinary VS debugging when you do NOT want the game exposed to the LAN. Auto-opens a browser, which is safe here because localhost navigates fine.

CastleDefenseGame2._comment: Same LAN binding as the 'http' profile; launchBrowser off for the same 0.0.0.0 reason.
